studies.authors: Strong R; Miller RA; Astle CM; Baur JA; de Cabo R; Fernandez E; Guo W; Javors M; Kirkland JL; Nelson JF; Sinclair DA; Teter B; Williams D; Zaveri N; Nadon NL; Harrison DE
